# Home {.unnumbered .unlisted}

::: {.otexts-cover logo="figs/weird-hex.png" alt="Front cover of That's weird! Anomaly detection using R, by Rob J Hyndman"}
[Free to read online]{.eyebrow}

A probabilistic perspective on finding and understanding anomalies.

For people doing data analysis without formal training in anomaly detection, and for students of statistics or data science.

Applications cover univariate and multivariate data, time series, functional data, images, videos, networks, and event data.

The [**`weird`** package](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/weird/) is used throughout, with R code provided for all examples.

[Start reading](preface.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
:::
